ideas.question: Does the proportion of SUID cases involving maternal stressors change over time?
ideas.comparison: ncfrp_v51 case series 2004-2019 with prams_p8_arf population reference Phase 8
ideas.why_open: No previous study has analyzed changes in the role of maternal stressors over time, which could provide insights into whether societal or economic factors influence SUID incidence.
ideas.data: Use the maternal stressors domain D100 from ncfrp_v51 to identify cases involving stressors such as financial problems or relationship issues. Compare these proportions over time with data on healthcare visits and other support services obtained from prams_p8_arf's D297.

ideas.question: Has the proportion of SUID cases related to preterm birth remained stable between 2016-2021?
ideas.comparison: ncfrp_v51 case series 2004-2019 with prams_p8_arf population reference Phase 8
ideas.why_open: This question explores whether the association between preterm birth and SUID has changed over time, potentially reflecting improvements or worsening in prenatal care.
ideas.data: Utilize the preterm birth history domain D67 from ncfrp_v51 to identify cases involving preterm infants. Compare these proportions over time with data on income and dependent information obtained from prams_p8_arf's D284.

ideas.question: Is there a trend in hospital overnight stays for SUID cases compared to the population?
ideas.comparison: ncfrp_v51 case series 1990-2020 with prams_p7_arf population reference Phase 7
ideas.why_open: This question investigates whether postnatal care, as indicated by hospital overnight stays, has changed over time and correlates with SUID incidence.
ideas.data: Use the hospital overnight stay domain D82 from ncfrp_v51 to identify cases involving extended postnatal care. Compare these proportions over time with data on health insurance coverage obtained from prams_p7_arf's D309.

ideas.question: Do changes in pre-pregnancy health checks correlate with SUID incidence trends?
ideas.comparison: ncfrp_v51 case series 2004-2019 with prams_p7_arf population reference Phase 7
ideas.why_open: This question aims to understand if improvements or declines in pre-pregnancy health checks have impacted SUID incidence, potentially indicating shifts in preventive healthcare practices.
ideas.data: Utilize the pre-pregnancy health checks domain D66 from ncfrp_v51 to identify cases with inadequate pre-pregnancy care. Compare these proportions over time with data on pre-pregnancy health checks obtained from prams_p7_arf's D304.

ideas.question: Has the proportion of SUID cases where mothers did not use birth control changed since 2016?
ideas.comparison: ncfrp_v51 case series 2008-2019 with prams_p7_arf population reference Phase 7
ideas.why_open: This question explores whether there have been changes in contraceptive usage among mothers of SUID cases, which could reflect broader trends in reproductive health practices.
ideas.data: Use the birth control use domain D83 from ncfrp_v51 to identify cases involving unintended pregnancies. Compare these proportions over time with data on reasons for not using birth control obtained from prams_p7_arf's D308.
